text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Is this it? Is it just... over for me?<n>Coming to Tracen
was a dream come<n>true, but as I gaze out across
campus,<n>the view has lost its rosy tint.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I first set foot on these grounds<n>convinced of my
future success as a<n>trainer. But now, that
confidence is all<n>but gone.
Goodness me, I've never heard a<n>sigh so heavy.

Did we hit a little bump in the road?<n>When you're
feeling down, it's no<n>good to stew on it all alone.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Me? Well, if you want to know,<n>Wonder Acute's
the name. I don't<n>believe we've met before.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hope I didn't startle you just now.<n>You looked like
you were about ready<n>to burst into tears, so I
thought I'd<n>ask what's the matter.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I let myself be seen<n>like this. It's a
trainer's job to listen<n>to students' career woes,
not the<n>other way around.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you poor thing, let's get that lost<n>puppy look off
your face. Maybe you<n>just need a bite to eat. How
about<n>some crunchy munchies?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
By "crunchy munchies" I'm guessing<n>she means
these pickled radishes.<n>Usually I'd pass, but I really
need this<n>right now.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Crunch... crunch...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The salty flavor reminds me of the<n>tears I'd been
holding back.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, if your taste buds are still<n>working, you'll be
all right yet. Now,<n>why don't you tell me what
happened? Take as much time as<n>you need.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At her gentle prodding, the words I'd<n>intended to
keep bottled up spill out of<n>my mouth.
choice_data_list: I... I'm unfit to be a trainer.
I... I'm unfit to be a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're changing my routineagain?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I was in a trial period with this<n>student. She needed
to improve her<n>explosiveness, so I suggested we
do<n>more uphill training.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her muscles had great potential for<n>speed, and my
aim was to unlock it<n>by pushing her to her limits.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I just... I don't like how we're doing<n>something
different every time. I've<n>asked around, and
everyone else's<n>routines sound way more
balanced.
choice_data_list: I want to utilize your strengths!
I want to utilize your strengths!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Can I really trust this trainer? Like,<n>I'm sure
winning whatever award at<n>trainer school is a big
deal, but still,<n>this is a fresh graduate we're talking
about...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, sorry, but could we forget<n>about the whole
training contract<n>thing?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, maybe it just wasn't meant<n>to be? But
surely just one rejection<n>is nothing to fuss over.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the few months I've been here, no<n>less than
eleven students have<n>turned down a contract with
me, if<n>you count those who didn't even<n>want to do a
trial period.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'm just not cut out to be a trainer...
Maybe I'm just not cut out to be a trainer...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now that's a load of baloney. You<n>take your job
serious enough to get<n>all tore up over it—that's got
to count<n>for something if you ask me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know, how about we try a little<n>something?
Trainer, do you have time<n>to spare right now?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm going to be competing in the<n>upcoming
Tracen Meet, you see. And<n>I figured I might as well
do my best to<n>prepare.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Meet is a race event held on<n>campus. Only
students can compete,<n>but spectators flock in from
all over.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Having a trainer to guide me would be<n>a big help,
don't you think? Though<n>you might not get much
satisfaction<n>watching a runner like me...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I should be happy for another chance<n>to prove
myself as a trainer. But if I<n>lose the trust of yet
another student...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, you look awfully anxious<n>about this. Don't
you worry, I'm<n>tougher than I look, so I know I can
handle anything you throw at me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
For starters, why don't I go and run a<n>quick lap? If
you notice anything I can<n>improve on, you can tell
me after.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I stop Wonder Acute just as she's<n>about to run off.
Something caught my<n>eye while she was doing
stretches.
choice_data_list: You should stretch your right leg a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's fairly common for one leg to be<n>more flexible
than the other. The<n>sooner she realizes this and
adjusts<n>her stretching routine accordingly, the
better.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
See? I knew it in my bones you'd<n>make a
trustworthy trainer! We only<n>just met, and you're
already looking<n>out for me.
choice_data_list: ...You don't find it overly pedantic and annoying?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Of course not, dear. You're only<n>saying it for my
sake. Not to mention, I<n>do notice that my right leg is
more<n>liable to give me trouble.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying I should be giving it<n>an extra
stretch before I run. Well,<n>you learn something new
every day.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I wake up the next morning at my<n>complete mess
of a desk, the result<n>of a long night of
brainstorming.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I would draw up one training plan,<n>only to
immediately scrap it for<n>another, the optimal plan
always just<n>out of reach. It seems I forgot to eat
and sleep.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
My next session with Wonder Acute<n>is in a few
hours. I hope she won't<n>find the new routine too
intense...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And a one, nice and low, and a two,<n>there we go.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. You're quite the early bird<n>today, aren't
you?
choice_data_list: You're getting your extra stretches in!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wouldn't want to let what you<n>taught me go
to waste, you know. Got<n>to make sure I'm all ready
for<n>another intense workout.
choice_data_list: Sounds like you're really fired up.
Sounds like you're really fired up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've been excited to see how you<n>train me—it's all I
could think about.<n>Now then, I say we get right to it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her eyes glimmer with<n>anticipation warms
my heart. As a<n>trainer, there really is no better
feeling<n>than earning the trust of your trainee.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I make up my mind to do as much as<n>I possibly can
for Wonder Acute in<n>the short time we have before
the<n>Tracen Meet.
